key_insight: UA-ChatDev improves multi-agent software development by estimating uncertainty at each step and only verifying low-confidence outputs before they propagate errors.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to make LLM-based coding workflows more reliable by reducing hallucination cascades in requirements, coding, testing, and refinement.
method: Uses token-level log probabilities to estimate response uncertainty.
Applies phase-aware thresholds to decide when retrieval-based verification should be triggered.
Coordinates multi-agent collaboration while selectively checking risky intermediate outputs.
evidence_signal: On the SRDD benchmark, the framework outperforms prior single-agent and multi-agent baselines on completeness, executability, consistency, and overall quality, with ablations and communication analyses supporting the gains.
watch_item: The extra verification step adds system complexity and may depend on well-calibrated thresholds and access to reliable retrieval sources.
paper_title: UA-ChatDev: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Agent Collaboration for Reliable Software Development
